credits.title: Selma
credits.overview: Neslihan, an unsuccessful actress, and her social media influencer friends break into the home of Selma—a woman suffering from Alzheimer’s—to secretly live-stream her for profit. As their viewership surges, the house begins to reveal its terrifying secrets, and the young women find themselves trapped in a lethal Dark W

credits.title: Chords of Change
credits.overview: During the Turkish artistic revolution of the 1930s, a group of pioneers staged Özsoy Opera, the first opera in the history of Turkish Republic.
